headline: Contra and the 30-lives cheat
title: Contra Konami Code | The 30 Lives Cheat | Classic Games
video_script: Contra, Konami's classic, first hit arcades in nineteen eighty seven. Two soldiers, Bill and Lance, fight off an alien invasion. The NES version had a famous cheat, the Konami Code: up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A, then start. It gave you thirty lives! How many times did you beat Contra? Comment below!

scenes.fact: UP UP DOWN DOWN LEFT RIGHT LEFT RIGHT B A

description: Contra (Konami, 1987) and the NES Konami Code - UP UP DOWN DOWN LEFT RIGHT LEFT RIGHT B A START for 30 lives.
